description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数，默认值为20。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. The default value is 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的 NextToken 参数值。
description.en: The query token. Set it to the NextToken value returned from the previous API call.

description.zh: 表示返回的未使用节点类型
description.en: The type of unused nodes to be returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo-controller list-free-nodes --next-token a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe4 --max-results 20 --machine-type mock-machine-type2 --hpn-zone A1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxno4vh5muoq --tags Value=129 Key=my_key --operating-states Unused --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eflo-controller ListFreeNodes --region cn-hangzhou --OperatingStates.1 Unused --Tags.1.Value 129 --NextToken a3f2224a5ec7224116c4f5246120abe4 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmxno4vh5muoq' --MaxResults 20 --MachineType 'mock-machine-type2' --Tags.1.Key my_key --HpnZone A1
